reviews.review_title: 5 star game but please add gun reloading
reviews.review_description: This is a phenomenal game and I look forward to playing it in my free time. There is something that I would appreciate being added to the game, and that is fun reloading. If you could be able to reload all of the guns and not just the shotgun. For example, you would be able to pull back the top part of the pistols and you would be able to pull back the pin on the revolvers. If you added that to this already fantastic game, it would make my day and the day of so many others.

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for your kind words and the detailed feedback! We're thrilled you're enjoying the game. Adding realistic reload animations for all weapons (not just the shotgun) is a great suggestion, and we've noted it for consideration in future updates. We appreciate your support and hope you continue enjoying the game!
